answer: At the sinkhole pump yard, look-alike crews tried to seize the morning karst draw. A claimant has to take a 3.1 kg ferrous bar off rack K-9, go down 28 wet steps into cistern vault 4, and seat the bar once on a 150 by 85 mm damp limestone tile at niche N-12 before the 04:41 drip bell. The warden checks the print is 55-62 mm wide, the bar mass stays within 60 g of 3.1 kg, and the descent took 65-95 s. A 440-tin fee is charged even if the claim fails. A smear wider than 8 mm, a late seat, or a cracked bar bans the sluice for 7 bells.
